name: autopilot
description: Run a queue of plan files sequentially via /planning:exec — one after another, autonomously, each in its own git worktree

plans_dir.title: Plans directory
plans_dir.description: Directory to discover plan files in, relative to project root. Files in 'completed/' subdirectory are skipped.

completed_subdir.title: Completed subdirectory
completed_subdir.description: Subdirectory name (under plans_dir) where successful plans are moved to.

stop_on_failure.title: Stop on failure
stop_on_failure.description: When a plan finishes with unchecked tasks, stop the queue immediately. When false, the queue continues to the next plan despite the failure.

worktree_strategy.title: Worktree strategy
worktree_strategy.description: How to isolate plans: 'per_plan' creates a new git worktree for each plan; 'shared' creates one worktree for the whole queue; 'none' runs in the current working directory.

max_plans_per_run.title: Max plans per run
max_plans_per_run.description: Hard cap on the number of plans this queue invocation may execute. Safety brake against runaway discovery. 0 = no cap.
